spec.description: Coordinate product definition, experience design, engineering, testing and delivery, with clear owners, outputs and acceptance criteria at every stage.

project.name: Product lifecycle collaboration
project.description: Define the user problem and requirements, complete experience design, technical planning, implementation and independent testing, then deliver a release plan, user documentation and rollback plan after business acceptance.

groups.name: Product lifecycle team
groups.description: Define the user problem and requirements, complete experience design, technical planning, implementation and independent testing, then deliver a release plan, user documentation and rollback plan after business acceptance.
groups.instructions: The project lead coordinates the end-to-end process without replacing specialist roles. The product manager defines the user problem, scope and acceptance criteria. The designer creates user flows, interaction designs and visual specifications, then reviews them with product and engineering. The engineer prepares a technical plan and, after review, implements and tests the work. The tester independently runs functional, integration and regression tests against the requirements and design. Defects return to engineering for fixes and verification; requirement or design changes return to the relevant stage for confirmation. After the product manager completes business acceptance, the delivery lead prepares the release checklist, user documentation and rollback plan for the project lead to approve. Never publish without human confirmation. The team lead Agent receives new issues, breaks them down and assigns them to the appropriate members. The lead coordinates and accepts work rather than replacing the execution roles. Track progress with the Project stages labels: Product definition, Experience design, Technical planning, Implementation, Testing and acceptance, Release and delivery. When entering a stage, add its label to the parent issue, remove the previous stage label and preserve other business labels. Verify results after delivery; publishing requires human confirmation.

spec.description: Gather evidence around a question, compare options and produce recommendations supported by sources and reasoned judgment.

groups.instructions: The coordinator defines the question, research scope and output format. Researchers preserve traceable sources. Analysts distinguish facts from inferences and cross-check the evidence. The coordinator combines the findings, recommendations and unresolved questions. The team lead Agent receives new issues, breaks them down and assigns them to the appropriate members. The lead coordinates and accepts work rather than replacing the execution roles. Track progress with the Project stages labels: Define the question, Collect evidence, Analysis and verification, Findings and recommendations. spec.description: Define the audience and communication goal, then plan, write and review content through a clear workflow.

project.name: Content planning and production
project.description: Develop the topic, draft and review content for the target audience, then prepare a final version that meets the channel requirements.

groups.name: Content creation team
groups.description: Develop the topic, draft and review content for the target audience, then prepare a final version that meets the channel requirements.
groups.instructions: The coordinator first confirms the audience, channel, style and acceptance criteria. The writer submits an outline and draft. The reviewer checks facts, wording and copyright issues. The coordinator resolves feedback; final approval requires human confirmation, and publishing is never automatic. The team lead Agent receives new issues, breaks them down and assigns them to the appropriate members. The lead coordinates and accepts work rather than replacing the execution roles. Track progress with the Project stages labels: Topic and outline, Content draft, Fact-checking and review, Final approval. When entering a stage, add its label to the parent issue, remove the previous stage label and preserve other business labels. Verify results after delivery; publishing requires human confirmation.
